identityRules: Original existing primary IDs and listing-link identities are retained.
Candidate manufacturer/variant links are attached with explicit review flags; they are not asserted as confirmed matches.
Standalone control configurations are grouped only by literal manufacturer/model/voltage and type. Original configuration values remain separately inspectable.

An approval configuration is attached to an equipment record only for a unique literal manufacturer/model identity with compatible declared voltage; multiple compatible variants retain candidate relationships.
Exact same-schema specification aliases retain all source rows.
Battery modules and integrated storage assemblies remain separate record types within the same storage collection.
All original 117 data blobs and all 117 XLSX downloads remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
